message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. In most U.S. cities, including Atlanta, noise complaints are handled by the city’s **Police Department** or the **Code Enforcement** office rather than by a “local council” (which in Atlanta would be the City Council, but they typically refer complaints to the appropriate department). ### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website.
• Navigate to the “Report a Problem” or “Noise Complaint” section.
• Fill out the form with details (time, location, description, and any evidence such as photos or audio).
• Submit the form. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/ | | **Phone** | • Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at **404‑656‑4000**.
• Tell them you’d like to file a noise complaint and provide the same details you would give on the online form. | 404‑656‑4000 | | **In Person** | • Go to the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Code Enforcement office.
• Speak with an officer or code enforcement officer and fill out a paper complaint form. | City Hall: 100 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | **Mail** | • Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta’s Code Enforcement office.
• Include your name, address, phone number, and a detailed description of the noise issue. | City Hall: 100 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 | ### Tips for a Successful Complaint 1. **Be Specific** – Include exact times, dates, and the location (street address or intersection). 2. **Provide Evidence** – If possible, attach photos, videos, or audio recordings that demonstrate the noise level. 3. **Keep Records** – Save copies of any forms you submit and note the reference number given by the police or code enforcement. 4. **Follow Up** – If you don’t hear back within a week, call the police department or code enforcement office to check on the status. ### When to Call 911 If the noise is part of a larger emergency (e.g., a fire, active shooter, or other immediate danger), call **911** instead of filing a routine noise complaint. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report noise complaints in Atlanta—just use the city’s police department or code enforcement channels. If you’re unsure which one to contact, the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line (404‑656‑4000) is a good starting point.
